# Vedaang Sharma — Portfolio

> Full Stack Developer building intelligent web applications, AI agent systems, computer vision models, distributed backends, and modern software architectures.

## Overview
Vedaang Sharma is a Full Stack Developer based in Gurugram, India, pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) in Cloud Computing and Full Stack Development at Vivekananda Global University, Jaipur (2024–2027, CGPA: 9.6/10). He develops production-grade web applications, on-device and cloud AI architectures, and has published peer-reviewed research in real-time computer vision.

For the comprehensive, extended technical knowledge base, see [Full Knowledge Base](https://vedaangsharma.in/llms-full.txt).
